explication: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger. Its principal runtime workflow is to execute guest PPU/SPU code, provide PS3 system and library behavior, and translate guest graphics and device activity to host services. The tree identifies these major subsystems, including audio, input, networking, and trophy management. The sampled excerpts do not show the application’s launch orchestration or most cross-subsystem calls, so the graph emphasizes documented domain boundaries and omits uncertain wiring; several capabilities are represented by their exact enclosing source directories.
